headline: China’s Huayou Acquires 22.5% Stake in Atlantic Lithium's Ghanaian Portfolio
summary: China’s Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt secured a 22.5% interest in Atlantic Lithium’s Ghanaian portfolio and committed $66 million toward the Ewoyaa project.
why: Strategic investments by international battery and mining firms in African lithium projects secure critical mineral supply chains for the electric vehicle industry.
